# A starting point {.unnumbered}

How do we infer a human past that has no surviving written account?

This guide is at the planning stage. This introduction describes its intended
scope; it does not yet contain teaching chapters.

## Proposed contents {.unnumbered}

- Evidence and dating methods.
- Human evolution and migration.
- Agriculture and settlement.

These topics are plans and may change as I learn. Each future chapter will begin
with a specific question, develop an explanation and give the reader something
to check or try.
